query:
insert into pending_oauth_login (
                token_hash,
                provider,
                provider_subject,
                email,
                expires_at
            )
            values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            on conflict (provider, provider_subject)
            do update set
                token_hash = excluded.token_hash,
                email = excluded.email,
                expires_at = excluded.expires_at,
                created_at = now()
